title: Custo policy document
description: Configures a capability for a specific enterprise/layer. Placed under PolicyEngine/Policies/{enterprise}/{layer}/...

layer.description: Policy layer. Must match the capability's layer and the folder it lives in.

capability.description: Capability this policy configures. Must exist in the capability catalog for this layer.

order.description: Execution order within the layer (ascending). Defaults to 1000 when omitted.

enabled.description: Whether this policy is applied. Disabled policies are loaded and skipped.
